Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the period below.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure period (all day)】

December 4, 2026 (Friday) through January 15, 2027 (Friday)

【Arrangements during the closure】

• In-library reading, book checkout, and book return are not available at the Children's Library.

• If you have reserved materials scheduled for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Hanno City Library instead.

• The book drop box remains available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
